title: Monoamine oxidase-A is a novel driver of stress-induced premature senescence through inhibition of parkin-mediated mitophagy

grounded.evidence_quote: Monoamine oxidase‐A (MAO‐A) is a mitochondrial FAD‐dependent enzyme that catalyses the oxidative deamination of serotonin and catecholamines and generates hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) as a by‐product of the enzymatic reaction.

grounded.context: cardiomyoblasts and primary cardiomyocytes, chronic MAO-A activation
grounded.evidence_quote: Moreover, we observe that ROS produced by MAO‐A lead to the accumulation of p53 in the cytosol where it inhibits parkin, an important regulator of mitophagy, resulting in mitochondrial dysfunction.
